name: Kribi
description: Pristine beaches, warm Atlantic waters, and the famous Lobe Waterfall. A perfect beach getaway in Cameroon's South region.

name: Mount Cameroon
description: The highest peak in West Africa (4,095m). Hike through lush rainforest, past steaming lava fields, to the summit near Limbe.

name: Foumban
description: Historic heart of the Bamoun Kingdom. Visit the Sultan's Palace, explore the vibrant craft market, and discover rich Bamileke heritage.

name: Waza National Park
description: Premier wildlife destination in the Sahel. Spot elephants, giraffes, lions, and hartebeest on guided game drives through savanna woodland.

name: Yaounde
description: Cameroon's verdant capital in the hills. Explore political landmarks, art galleries, bustling markets, and lush parks.

name: Douala
description: Economic capital and cultural hub. Enjoy vibrant nightlife, river views, contemporary art, and the freshest seafood.

name: Bamenda
description: Highland city with panoramic views, traditional grass-roofed architecture, and a rich cultural tapestry of the Northwest region.

name: Dschang
description: A charming highland town known for its steep valleys, cascading waterfalls, and cool climate. A nature lover's retreat.

name: Maroua
description: Cultural gateway to the Mandara Mountains. Experience unique Lamido palaces, craft pottery, and the rhythm of northern life.

name: Bertoua
description: Explore the dense tropical forests of the East. Wildlife, pygmy settlements, and the serene Lobé River set this region apart.

name: Ngaoundere
description: Gateway to the Adamawa Plateau. Ride horseback, visit crater lakes, and experience Fulani culture in this highland town.

name: Bafoussam
description: Commercial heart of the West region. Great food, warm hospitality, and easy access to nearby waterfalls and palaces.

name: Kumbo
description: Famous for its annual Nchinda horse festival and traditional sheep farming. A unique glimpse into Kom culture.

name: Ebolowa
description: A peaceful gateway to the South's dense rainforests. Ideal for eco-tourism and plantation tours of cocoa and palm oil.

name: Garoua
description: Historic riverside town on the Benue River. A key trading hub with access to colonial forts and vibrant fishing culture.

name: Limbe
description: Black sand beaches against the backdrop of Mount Cameroon. Visit the Limbe Wildlife Centre and enjoy coastal charm.
